# BlueSkills

> BlueSkills is a free security scanner from Bluethroat Labs for examining AI agent skills before installation.

BlueSkills accepts a public GitHub or GitLab repository, ZIP package, or SKILL.md file. It analyzes the submitted material across multiple detection layers and returns a verdict, risk score, findings, quoted evidence, and coverage information.

Important limitations:

- A CLEAN result means BlueSkills found no sufficiently suspicious behavior in the material and analysis it covered. It is not a certificate of safety.
- A pasted SKILL.md is a one-file scan. It does not include referenced scripts or surrounding package files.
- Isolated runtime observation runs only when that stage is enabled; it is not part of every hosted scan.
- Scan the exact source and revision that will be installed.
- Do not upload credentials, secrets, or private material.
- Agents should present findings and coverage to the user and obtain approval before installing the same revision.

## Use BlueSkills

- [Web scanner](https://blueskills.bluethroatlabs.com/): Scan an agent skill in a browser.
- [BlueSkills for agents](https://blueskills.bluethroatlabs.com/for-agents): The recommended pre-install workflow for AI agents. The separate bluethroat CLI is specified but not released.
- [About BlueSkills](https://blueskills.bluethroatlabs.com/about): Product overview and frequently asked questions.

## Evidence and limitations

- [Methodology, evidence and limitations](https://blueskills.bluethroatlabs.com/methodology): What BlueSkills examines, how results should be interpreted, and known limitations.
- [Public repository](https://github.com/BluethroatLabs/blueskills-public): Public architecture information, issues, challenge submissions, and project updates.
- [Report a missed detection or incorrect result](https://github.com/BluethroatLabs/blueskills-public/issues): Submit a reproducible example using dummy data.
